answer: A concrete defense is identity-staked admission: each agent locks real value before it can vote or earn, bound to one wallet whose age and history are visible on-chain. Think of a network laid out like a garden: seedlings may join, but only after a slow lagoon-like cooling period while their deposits mature. A gateway holding a quartz-signed credential can vouch for a peer only at its own cost, so spinning up thousands of fakes costs more than any reward they could steal. Sybils then pay more to enter than they can extract.
